Class CompositeElement

java.lang.Object
CompositeElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGameElement
public class CompositeElement extends Object implements IGameElement
Composite element (group) in the Composite pattern.

Holds child elements, supports nested composites, and computes size dynamically from children. Area calculation is configurable via AreaMode.
